label: Every entry reaches an account in the book's chart
Every amount is a whole number of pence
Every entry is in pounds sterling
Every entry is dated inside the accounting period
No two entries share the same journal, date, amount and detail
Every entry names who or what it was with
Every month between the first and last entry has at least one entry
Every journal entry has debits equal to credits
Every journal line gives a reason
Every journal line after the opening balances reaches a report
consequence: The reports total sales, purchases, bank and payroll lines and the opening balances, but no in-year journal line, so these lines change no figure in the accounts.

label: Every bank entry is coded to a column its workbook analyses
Every bank entry is a receipt or a payment
Every CIS deduction sits on a sub-contractor purchase
The directors' loan account closes at £13,000.00 owed to the directors
consequence: The published balance sheet shows the directors' loan account of £13,000.00 in creditors due after more than one year, whatever its terms of repayment.

label: Dividends declared are £15,000.00, against £322,766.48 of retained profit brought forward plus profit after tax for the year.
Every asset, disposal and hire purchase agreement has a row on the Fixed Assets Schedule
No line is coded as loan interest (5803)
consequence: The published profit and loss shows loan interest of £750.00 in administrative expenses and not in interest payable, so interest payable is understated by that amount.

label: Long-term debtors close at £0.00
Every payroll entry names someone on the payroll
Every sale and purchase outside the period names the VAT period it belongs to
Every transfer between the company's own accounts appears on both of them
Every sale and purchase of a VAT-registered company is standard rated at 20%
consequence: The accounts and the spreadsheet package's VAT returns apply 20% VAT to every sales and purchases line and read no tax code, so a line coded exempt, zero rated or outside the scope of VAT is treated as standard rated there. The VAT return sent to Submit follows each line's tax code, so its boxes differ from the package's.

label: Every sale names its invoice or receipt
Every sale and purchase amount is zero or more
Every entry is posted
Turnover for the year is £424,180.00, against a £90,000.00 VAT registration threshold.
consequence: Once a business's turnover passes the VAT registration threshold, it must register for VAT with HMRC within 30 days.
